_comment: Firestore/Storage RULES are intentionally NOT declared here. The web repo (pairra-web) is the single source of truth for security rules and owns deployment to project pairra-app-e104f. Do NOT add `firestore`/`storage` rule targets back — deploying rules from this repo would overwrite the live ruleset with a stale subset (missing auditLog/adminUsers/datePlans/gameSessions/purchases) and break the web app. See firestore.rules here for reference only.
